E26-notexc.quote: Providers are still required to comply with the 2-midnight rule during the exemption period, and CMS or its contractors may still conduct patient status medical review in cases in which there is evidence of systemic fraud or abuse occurring.

E26-50.claim: CY2026: Secretary determination is >50 percent outpatient in a single calendar year
E26-50.quote: the determination of the Secretary that a service or procedure is more commonly performed in the outpatient setting is based on claims data that demonstrates that the service or procedure is being performed more than 50 percent of the time in the outpatient setting in a single calendar year

E26-notyet.claim: CY2026: no exemption has yet been ended; process via notice and comment rulemaking
E26-notyet.quote: through the process of ending the exemption period for an indefinitely exempted procedure, we will establish that process, including the effective date of the end of the exemption period, through notice and comment rulemaking

E26-firsttime.claim: CY2026: first time Secretary determines, announce via notice and comment rulemaking
E26-firsttime.quote: the first time that the Secretary determines that a service or procedure is more commonly performed in the outpatient setting than the inpatient setting, we will make the announcement that the exemption is ending for the service or procedure through notice and comment rulemaking.

E26-final.claim: CY2026 final: continue indefinite exemption; revise 412.3(d)(2)
E26-final.quote: We are finalizing our proposal to (1) continue the indefinite exemption from site-of-service claim denials, initial medical review contractor referrals to RACs, and RAC reviews for ``patient status'' (that is, site-of-service) finalized in the CY 2021 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period for procedures that are removed from the IPO list in CY 2021 or later under the OPPS;

E26-MA.claim: CY2026: MA plans required to comply with 2-midnight benchmark
E26-MA.quote: Medicare Advantage plans are required to comply with the 2-midnight benchmark.

Y27-1438.claim: CY2027: 1,438 services remaining; proposed to remove approximately half (637)
Y27-1438.quote: Currently, there are 1,438 services remaining on the IPO list. For CY 2027, we proposed to remove approximately half of the remaining IPO services as the second phase of the elimination of the IPO list.

Y27-families.quote: we proposed to remove 637 services from the following clinical families: auditory, digestive, endocrine, female genital, hemic and lymphatic systems, integumentary, male genital, maternity care and delivery, mediastinum and diaphragm, respiratory, and urinary.

Y27-final637.claim: CY2027 final: finalizing removal of 637 services (second phase)
Y27-final637.quote: we are finalizing our proposal to remove 637 services from the IPO list for CY 2027 as the second phase of the elimination of the IPO list.

Y27-2028a.claim: CY2027: remaining clinical families to be removed for CY2028 (third and final phase)
Y27-2028a.quote: We expect that these remaining clinical families and services would be removed from the IPO list for CY 2028, during the third and final phase of the elimination.

Y27-2028b.claim: CY2027: CY2028 families: neurological, cardiovascular, solid organ, intestinal, islet cell transplants
Y27-2028b.quote: procedures for removal in CY 2028 would be from the neurological family, cardiovascular family, solid organ, intestinal, and islet cell transplants and related services.

Y27-all2028.claim: CY2027: expects to address all remaining clinical families during CY 2028 rulemaking
Y27-all2028.quote: we expect to address all of the remaining clinical families and their removal during CY 2028 rulemaking.

Y27-regn.claim: CY2027 recounts: 419.22(n) effective 1/1/2026, list eliminated by January 1, 2029 (90 FR 53788-53789, 54086; 91 FR 8384)
Y27-regn.quote: effective on January 1, 2026, the Secretary shall eliminate the list of services and procedures designated as requiring inpatient care through a 3-year transition period, with the list eliminated in its entirety by January 1, 2029 (90 FR 53788 to 53789 and 54086; 91 FR 8384).

Y27-285.claim: CY2027 recounts CY2026: removed 285 mostly MSK procedures
Y27-285.quote: we again finalized a policy to eliminate the IPO list over the course of three years, beginning by removing 285 mostly musculoskeletal procedures for CY 2026 (90 FR 53780 through 53802).

Y27-pre.claim: CY2027 recounts CY2021 and CY2022 histories (298; halted)
Y27-pre.quote: we removed 298 codes, including 266 musculoskeletal-related services, from the list beginning in CY 2021.

Y27-ASC618.claim: CY2027: 618 codes added to ASC CPL (recommended or removed from IPO)
Y27-ASC618.quote: we are continuing to expand the ASC covered procedures list (CPL) by adding 618 codes to the ASC CPL that were recommended by interested parties or were finalized for removal from the IPO list for CY 2027.

Y27-ASC618b.claim: CY2027 proposal: 618 procedures proposed for removal from IPO list to be added to ASC CPL
Y27-ASC618b.quote: Several commenters supported our proposal to add 618 procedures proposed for removal from the IPO list to the ASC CPL for CY 2027.

Y27-file.claim: CY2027: removed services listed in public use file, not in a table; Addendum E is complete list
Y27-file.quote: These services and their final status indicators and APC assignments (if applicable) are listed in the public use file titled ``Final Procedures Removed from the IPO List for CY 2027'', which is available on the CMS website.

Y27-addE.claim: CY2027: Addendum E complete list of IPO services
Y27-addE.quote: The complete list of codes that describe services that are finalized to be paid by Medicare in CY 2027 as inpatient only services is included as Addendum E

Y27-addB.claim: CY2027 proposed: Addendum B included proposed removals; Addendum E list
Y27-addB.quote: The services proposed for removal from the IPO list for CY 2027 and their proposed status indicators and APC assignments (if applicable) were also included in Addendum B

Y27-T79.claim: CY2027: Table 79 is APC reassignment requests, not the removal list
Y27-T79.quote: The proposed and final APC and status indicator assignments for procedures for which commenters requested APC reassignments are listed in Table 79 below.

Y27-deleted.claim: CY2027: codes not proposed for removal because deleted by AMA
Y27-deleted.quote: were not proposed for removal as these codes are being deleted by the AMA. They will no longer be effective starting in CY 2027.

Y27-cpl-keep.claim: CY2027: 0235T etc. not accepted for removal; will be with their clinical families
Y27-cpl-keep.quote: We plan to remove these procedures in future rulemaking with procedures in their clinical families

Y27-no-need.claim: CY2027: not necessary to maintain an IPO list
Y27-no-need.quote: Therefore, we continue to believe it is not necessary for us to maintain an IPO list

E27-indef.claim: CY2027: indefinite exemption restated; what is exempted and condition for ending
E27-indef.quote: procedures removed from the IPO list on or after January 1, 2021, are indefinitely exempted from site-of-service claim denials, initial medical review contractor referrals to RACs, and RAC reviews for ``patient status'' (that is, site-of-service) until the Secretary determines that the service or procedure is more commonly performed in the outpatient setting than the inpatient setting.

E27-50.claim: CY2027: exemption ends for a procedure only when >50 percent outpatient in a single calendar year
E27-50.quote: For the exemption to end for a specific procedure, in a single calendar year we would need to have Medicare claims data indicating that the procedure was performed more than 50 percent of the time in the outpatient setting.

E27-announce.claim: CY2027: end of exemption announced via rulemaking
E27-announce.quote: We noted that the end of the exemption period for each procedure removed from the IPO list on or after January 1, 2021 would be announced via rulemaking.

E27-educ.claim: CY2027: contractors may review for education but claims not denied during exemption
E27-educ.quote: During the exemption period, Medicare review contractors have the opportunity to review such claims in order to provide education for practitioners and providers regarding compliance with the 2-midnight rule, but claims identified as noncompliant are not denied with respect to the site-of-service under Medicare Part A.

E27-26ref.claim: CY2027 refers readers to CY2026 discussion at 90 FR 53827-53832
E27-26ref.quote: We also refer commenters to the full discussion on these exemptions in section X.D. of the CY 2026 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (90 FR 53827 through 53832).

E27-MA.claim: CY2027: MA plans must comply with the 2-midnight rule
E27-MA.quote: These requirements mean that MA plans must comply with the 2-midnight rule and may not treat removal from the IPO list as requiring those procedures to be performed in the outpatient setting.

E27-notrequire.claim: CY2027: removal does not require outpatient-only performance
E27-notrequire.quote: the removal of a service from the IPO list does not require the service to be performed only on an outpatient basis.

E27-eliminated.claim: CY2027: policy not to deny; exemption prevents burden of audits and denials
E27-eliminated.quote: will prevent hospitals from the burden of audits and denials due to furnishing former IPO procedures in the inpatient setting.

E27-noshift.claim: CY2027: do not anticipate limits on Part A access (SNF concern response)
E27-noshift.quote: we do not anticipate to see large shifts in site-of-care due to the elimination of the IPO list

C-2029.claim: Correction notice 2026-03578 (91 FR 8383-8385): corrects January 1, 2028 to January 1, 2029 on 90 FR 53789
C-2029.quote: 6. On page 53789, second column, first line, the date ``January 1, 2028'' is corrected to read ``January 1, 2029''.

C-2029-sum.claim: Correction notice summary: correcting an error in the final date of elimination of the IPO list
C-2029-sum.quote: On page 53789, we are correcting an error in the final date of the elimination of the Inpatient Only list.

C-T119.claim: Correction notice: Table 119 descriptor corrections for 20802 and 20805 (descriptor only)
C-T119.quote: On page 53791, in the table titled ``TABLE 119: FINAL PROCEDURES FOR REMOVAL FROM THE IPO LIST FOR CY 2026'', we are correcting an error in the long descriptors for CPT codes 20802 and 20805.

C-419.claim: CY2027 final rule adds a new 419.23 (off-campus outpatient department rule) - unrelated to IPO
C-419.quote: 6. Adding Sec. 419.23 to subpart B to read as follows: Sec. 419.23 Special rule for off-campus outpatient department of a provider.

E21-cfrtext-ii.quote: (ii) For those services and procedures removed on or after January 1, 2021, the exemption in this paragraph (d)(2) will last until the Secretary determines that the service or procedure is more commonly performed in the outpatient setting.
